# bundled-notes-mcp

Unofficial FastMCP 3 server for Bundled Notes Web using Firebase Auth refresh tokens, Firestore REST, and Firebase Storage REST.

Entry point: `src/bundled_notes_mcp/server.py`
Hosted endpoint: `https://bundled-notes-mcp.fastmcp.app/mcp` (Prefect Horizon authentication required)
Tool catalog: `src/bundled_notes_mcp/tools.py`
Domain operations: `src/bundled_notes_mcp/client.py`
Auth/config: `src/bundled_notes_mcp/auth.py`, `config.py`
Wire codec: `src/bundled_notes_mcp/firestore.py`
Enums/schemas: `src/bundled_notes_mcp/models.py`
Storage: `src/bundled_notes_mcp/storage.py`

Rules: every write requires `confirm=true`; never expose tokens; prefer archive over delete; delete bundle/template recursively; partial-patch existing docs; re-read writes; verify Storage size/metadata before committing attachment references; do not retry non-idempotent calls.
Hosted data controls: keep MCP request and response payload logging disabled.

Tools:
- `bundled_status`
- `bundled_current_user`
- `bundled_list_bundles`
- `bundled_get_bundle`
- `bundled_create_bundle`
- `bundled_update_bundle`
- `bundled_set_bundle_archived`
- `bundled_delete_bundle`
- `bundled_list_entries`
- `bundled_get_entry`
- `bundled_search_entries`
- `bundled_create_entry`
- `bundled_update_entry`
- `bundled_set_entry_state`
- `bundled_delete_entry`
- `bundled_duplicate_entry`
- `bundled_move_entry`
- `bundled_list_tags`
- `bundled_create_tag`
- `bundled_update_tag`
- `bundled_apply_tag`
- `bundled_remove_tag`
- `bundled_delete_tag`
- `bundled_configure_kanban`
- `bundled_move_kanban_entry`
- `bundled_list_templates`
- `bundled_create_template`
- `bundled_apply_template`
- `bundled_delete_template`
- `bundled_list_attachments`
- `bundled_upload_attachment`
- `bundled_remove_attachment`
- `bundled_delete_account_attachment`

Verification: `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run pytest`, `uv build`.
